author: ojiudezue
title: Post-v5.77.0: census restored, hollow-anchor #7, mDNS/amcrest, EV-card verdict, duplicate-sensor catch
why: Census regression root-caused to strict-suffix matchers orphaned by F1 entity death (daily max 6-7 -> 4, dated to 08-13 in recorder) — the operator's 'it used to work' reframed a design proposal into a restore-fix a tenth the size. v5.77.0 shipped suffix-tolerant matching; F2-side tuning (13+3 cams Low->Medium) already shows 2.5x recognition rate, 8x for Oji.

Hollow-anchor variant #7 coined: comment-out evades grep anchors (string matches inside comments); different neuter shapes evade different anchors; the blocker fix's 'behavioral' test drove the helper, not the setup path. AST live-Call-node anchors are the fix. Caught by orchestrator re-drill using a different mutation style than the builder.

Amcrest 'mDNS error' was three layers deep: not the IP (never changed), not the host field (custom component IGNORES it when an mdns block exists — live-resolves at every setup), fix = recreate entry in URL mode. Lesson: read a custom component's async_setup_entry before assuming standard semantics. Pool-overhead is watched by 4 integrations (operator: artifact, not architecture — recorded, do-not-relitigate).
EVCARD-1 operator verdict 'poor — as if you did not review the main sensors': design without sensor discovery is decoration. Redesign dispatched with discovery as step 1.

PWA-CONTROL-LIST duplicate catch: operator's 'we have a device list sensor' was right — DevicesSensor already exposes the full controllable-entities ground truth; card re-scoped to zero URA code (13 registry enables + PWA-side consumption).
